Instruments.help:
PROPULSION
AUTO prefers a usable running torch where permitted, with RCS fallback. RCS inhibits Auto Nav torch burns. This dial does not ignite the reactor.

DIALS
Click the left/right half, use the wheel, or drag up/down. Focused arrow keys also step. Amber values mean locked settings; Details remains available.

STOP / COAST
Ends guidance and removes commanded thrust. It does not brake.

Use phobosnav arrival <km> for exact custom distances. No docking, obstacle avoidance or station keeping.

NavigationService.phobosnav_help_status_:
phobosnav help | status | settings | fly [arrival-km] | arrival <km> | torch <on|off> | stop | spawn
Torch-preferred approach with RCS fallback, including below 5,000 km; no minimum engagement range. Arrival is the stopping distance, not a minimum starting range. Example: fly 0.5 requests 500 m; hull clearance can increase it. arrival saves a default while disengaged. Fly overrides apply only to that flight. Stop clears thrust; it does not brake. Ordinary saves supported; spawn is a debug grant.
phobosnav resume — resume the saved flight; phobosnav forget — stop and discard saved flight data on the open console.

Overlay.PhobosNavModAutoNav.description: An aftermarket module for a Polaris navigation station. Torch-preferred approach and braking with RCS fallback and native no-wake protection, including below 5,000 km, with adjustable stopping distance and hull clearance. Repair and Restore for reuse, or dismantle into retained board residue. Does not dock, avoid obstacles or hold position.
Overlay.PhobosNavModAutoNav.name: Phobos Polaris Auto Nav Module
Overlay.PhobosNavModAutoNavDmg.descripti: A damaged Phobos Polaris Auto Nav Module. Repair with two small electronic parts, then Restore its remaining wear before use. Fits a Polaris navigation station. Dismantling retains 0.4 kg of board residue.
Overlay.PhobosNavModAutoNavDmg.name: Phobos Polaris Auto Nav Module (Damaged)

Plugin.allowed_speed_error_at_arrival_no: Allowed speed error at arrival; not a station-keeping guarantee.
Plugin.arrival_relative_speed_zero_reque: Arrival relative speed. Zero requests braking to a stop. Captured on engagement.
Plugin.centre_to_centre_arrival_distance: Centre-to-centre stopping distance in km (not minimum engagement range); larger hulls require extra clearance. New configurations default to 1 km; existing settings are preserved. F3: phobosnav arrival <km> saves a default; phobosnav fly <km> overrides one flight.
Plugin.check_the_inherited_approximate_d: Check the conservative RCS fallback delta-v budget before departure, even with torch preference; not a fuel guarantee.
Plugin.cruise_speed_relative_to_target_c: Cruise speed relative to target. Captured on engagement.
Plugin.legacy_guidance_check_phobos_alwa: Legacy guidance check. Phobos always yields to external maneuver commands regardless of this value.
Plugin.master_switch_switching_off_abort: Master switch; switching off aborts an active flight.
Plugin.use_rcs_turning_false_retains_ups: Use RCS turning. False retains upstream's instantaneous heading change for comparisons.
Plugin.velocity_error_before_a_cruise_co: Minimum cruise velocity-error band in m/s. The resume threshold is the greater of this and CoastSpeedTolerancePercent of cruise speed. Sideways drift and braking can demand correction sooner. Captured on engagement.
Plugin.coast_speed_tolerance_percent: Cruise velocity-error band as a percentage of requested cruise speed. Higher values favour coasting. Added alongside existing CoastToleranceMS; does not relax arrival speed or braking. Captured on engagement.
Plugin.coast_enter_fraction: Fraction of the resume threshold at which a cruise correction stops and coasting begins (0.75 means 75%). The higher resume threshold prevents rapid switching. Captured on engagement.
Plugin.burn_heading_tolerance_degrees: Heading deadband in degrees while making a course correction. During coasting, do not chase target heading; only damp significant spin. Captured on engagement.
NavigationService.coast_settings: Coasting ({6}): resume at max({0} m/s, {1}% of cruise); stop correcting at {2}% of that band. Burn heading tolerance {3} degrees. Sideways drift guard: {5}% of arrival radius over {4} s. Braking takes priority.
